name: ntr_db_renasight_avg_quota_attainment
xsql:
SELECT 
    Round(Coalesce(AVG(individual_attainment), 0.00), 2) AS Average_Quarterly_Attainment
FROM (
    SELECT 
        q.position_id,
        Coalesce(c.credit_amount, 0.00) AS total_credits,
        Coalesce(q.quota_amount, 0.00) AS total_quota,
        CASE 
            WHEN Coalesce(q.quota_amount, 0.00) = 0 THEN 0.00
            ELSE ((Coalesce(c.credit_amount, 0.00) / q.quota_amount) * 100)
        END AS individual_attainment
    FROM (
        SELECT qa.assignment_id AS position_id, SUM(qa.amount) AS quota_amount
        FROM xactly.xc_quota_assignment qa
        INNER JOIN xactly.xc_quota q_tbl ON qa.quota_id = q_tbl.quota_id
        INNER JOIN $framework.ntr_db_get_position_region_mapping pos_reg ON qa.assignment_id = pos_reg.master_position_id
        WHERE qa.assignment_type = 2
          AND q_tbl.name = 'Renasight Goal'
          AND qa.period_id = :v_period_id
          AND qa.assignment_id IN :v_child_master_position_id
        AND (:p_region = 'ALL' or pos_reg.region in (:p_region))
        GROUP BY qa.assignment_id
    ) q
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT cs.position_id, SUM(cs.Total_amount) AS credit_amount
        FROM xactly.xc_credit_summary cs
        INNER JOIN $framework.ntr_db_get_position_region_mapping pos_reg ON cs.position_id = pos_reg.master_position_id
        WHERE cs.credit_type_name = 'Renasight'
          AND cs.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
          AND cs.position_id IN :v_child_master_position_id
          AND (:p_region = 'ALL' or pos_reg.region in (:p_region))
        GROUP BY cs.position_id
    ) c ON q.position_id = c.position_id
) sub
